resources.string: Add extra security blocks
Optional protections you can enable manually
Extra security blocks
These protections are optional and stay separate from HardBlock’s automatic blocking protections.
Block installation from unknown app sources
Closes the Android screens that allow installing apps from unknown sources, through the accessibility service, like the protection against disabling accessibility. No Device Owner needed.
Before turning on the protection

For the unknown-sources install block to work, first turn off the apps that already have this permission.\n\nTap Open unknown sources and turn everything off: open each app listed as allowed and switch off “Allow from this source”. Then come back to HardBlock.
Open unknown sources
Everything turned off?
Once every app has “Allow from this source” off, turn on the protection. From then on, HardBlock closes the screens that grant this permission.
